name: Can smart home upgrades be integrated into an existing home in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, or are they only for new construction?

mainEntity.name: Can smart home upgrades be integrated into an existing home in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, or are they only for new construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smart home upgrades can certainly be integrated into existing homes within the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, not just new construction. For substantial, coordinated residential renovations, particularly whole-home remodels or additions, integrating smart features is highly feasible. While new construction offers a blank slate, AKN Design Group's expertise lies in transforming existing properties. We assess your current home's infrastructure and propose solutions that can be seamlessly incorporated, ensuring they align with local DFW building codes and complement the existing architecture. Our design-build process manages these complexities to deliver a cohesive outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smart home upgrades can be integrated into existing homes in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, especially during substantial renovations like whole-home remodels, with AKN Design Group managing infrastructure assessment and local building code adherence.
